title: Verify: Second NPC spawn and idle animation unit tests
summary: Unit tests for manifest idle resolution and BootScene NPC spawn
description: Write game/tests/npcIdle.test.ts for the resolver and game/frontend/tests/bootSceneNpc.test.ts for spawn, mocking Phaser and content like bootSceneCharacters.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: BootScene creates two sprites and NPC plays character:npc:idle

steps.symbol: new: resolves NPC idle from manifest
steps.action: Create an in-memory manifest with a character:npc spritesheet defining idle, a CharacterSpec with idle ref character:npc/idle, call resolveCharacterAnimation(spec,'idle',manifest) and characterAnimationKey on the result; assert asset character:npc and key 'character:npc:idle'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/npcIdle.test.ts

steps.action: Copy the vi.mock('phaser') and vi.mock('../src/runtime/content') setup from bootSceneCharacters.test.ts, add npc to world.characters, scene.characters and manifest; call new BootScene().create() and assert add.sprite called twice and the second sprite's play was called with 'character:npc:idle'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneNpc.test.ts
steps.expected: Test passes: two sprites, NPC idle key played
